searches.query: Infinite Sugar

claims.claim: Infinite Sugar is an inspectable software artwork that visualizes connectome-derived activity in an embodied virtual fly.
claims.population_or_data: as described by the primary source
claims.limitation: The repository is a browser artwork using FlyWire connectivity and simplified LIF-style activity. Several body movements use supplied patterns; it is not a validated whole-brain emulation or nociception model.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use only within the documented scope and limitations.

decisions.notes: The repository is a browser artwork using FlyWire connectivity and simplified LIF-style activity. Several body movements use supplied patterns; it is not a validated whole-brain emulation or nociception model.

claims.claim: Repeated nociceptor activation and octopaminergic feedback increase sensory gain and nocifensive rolling in Drosophila larvae.
claims.population_or_data: as described by the primary source
